MRT.note: The ministry data centre is described as hosting government servers, not as renting to other organisations; no Tier stated.

facts.fact: Minister of Digital Transformation told the National Assembly that all government servers were moved into a data centre the ministry built to international standards.
Minister said Mauritania launched its first national cloud days earlier, ending reliance on foreign clouds for digital services.
Minister told the National Assembly that several digital services are now available to citizens; no count or portal named.
